notes: Banner system fixes: every banner now shows an edition-colored chip (DEFAULT green / DEV cyan / STUDENT purple / ZEN gold) so it's instantly clear which edition the update is for. Also fixed a logic bug that prevented secondary 'try the X edition' banners from firing across editions with independent version lines (Main on 1.4.x couldn't see Zen 1.0.x banners and vice versa).
